item.title: February is Sweet as Candy on ONETV with a Month Full of Movies We Love
item.description: Love "Love Movies"? This month is "Sweet as Candy February" on ONETV as we celebrate love like no one else.

item.title: Emmerdale Celebrates 50 Unforgettable Years of Drama in the Dales with One-Hour Special
item.description: It's been 50 years of Emmerdale! To celebrate this monumental anniversary, cast members and producers of the hit, multi-award winning series have gathered for an emotional and hilarious walk down memory lane. The Emmerdale: 50 Unforgettable Years special airs Saturday, February 11 at 6:30pm ET.

item.title: Struggle and Romance in Regency-Era London: Dickens' Little Dorrit Comes to ONETV
item.description: If you can't get enough of period dramas, there’s no doubt you’ll love the BBC's powerful adaptation of the Charles Dickens classic Little Dorrit. What can you expect from this timeless tale? Read on to find out!

item.title: From Austen to Oscar: The Ascension of the Stars of Pride and Prejudice
item.description: Colin Firth and Jennifer Ehle star in Pride and Prejudice on ONETV, the acclaimed 1995 BBC mini-series adapted by Andrew Davies from Jane Austen's classic novel. Let's take a look at what the series' stars have been up to since then.

item.title: Uncovering Five Fascinating Facts About Midsomer Murders
item.description: What exactly has captivated devoted fans all these years? Let’s take a look at some fascinating facts about the series that might give some clues as to why Midsomer Murders has been such a hit for so long.

item.title: Lorelai and Rory's Most Quotable Quotes on Gilmore Girls
item.description: Revisit some of the most memorable lines shared between Lorelai and Rory that capture their unique dynamic.

item.title: Emmerdale Wins Best Soap at the UK's TV Choice Awards
item.description: Emmerdale was honoured at the UK's 2025 TV Choice Awards with another win for Best Soap and a Best Soap Newcomer honour for actress Beth Cordingly.

item.title: EastEnders Celebrates Its 40th Anniversary With Explosive Special Episodes
item.description: EastEnders is celebrating 40 years on the air! The long-running series is marking this monumental anniversary with a week's worth of explosive episodes, including a special hour-long episode and a live episode with a one-of-a-kind twist.

item.title: March into ONETV for a Canada-Wide Free Preview
item.description: This March, you can get ONETV for free all month long! Get more thrilling mysteries, delightfully juicy dramas and home workout shows that will put some spring in your step as we say bye-bye to winter.

item.title: Preserving the Future: An MZTV Talk with MIT's Peter B Kaufman
item.description: Moses Znaimer, founder and CEO of ZoomerMedia Limited and the MZTV Museum of Television, talks with author and MIT Associate Director of Open Learning Peter B. Kaufman on preservation, archives, truth, and media’s shifting role in the digital age.
